transcript.text: Thank you, everyone. Now I need to share my findings regarding the publisher's current license terms. I reviewed the publisher's current license and confirmed two critical requirements. First, the district must provide one individually assigned digital account per student and one authorized print copy per student — the license does not permit the shared classroom-code digital access that the draft plan currently proposes. Second, the license permits 96 print copies for this cohort, which matches our expected enrollment of 96 students — but the draft plan only proposes 80 printed copies, which would fall short. So we need to revise the plan to provide individually assigned digital accounts for all 96 students, replace the shared classroom-code access model, and increase the print copies from 80 to 96 before this plan is finalized.
